Acme Gear: Outdoor Equipment for Weekend Explorers

Acme Gear designs and sells durable outdoor equipment, including tents, backpacks, and cookware, built for weekend explorers who camp in unpredictable weather. Every product is tested in real field conditions before it reaches our catalog, and we back each item with a two-year repair-or-replace warranty.

Our flagship product, the Tent X1, is a three-season, two-person tent engineered for fast setup and reliable weatherproofing. It is designed for backpackers and weekend campers who need gear that performs without extra weight. Acme Gear is based in Denver, Colorado, and ships across the continental United States.

Why campers choose Acme Gear

We publish exact specifications, verified weights, and real customer photos for every product page, so buyers know precisely what they are ordering before checkout. Our support team answers questions about sizing, weatherproofing ratings, and repair options directly, without routing customers through a chatbot first.
